How To: Requisition Entry in Banner

From the ORA eTraining module "Purchasing with Purpose: Procurement on Sponsored Projects" (lesson 5 of 15).
Procurements in Banner Self-Service
Requisitions are used to formally initiate purchases in Banner and provide the information needed to route the request for review, approval, and purchase order creation. During requisition entry, users identify the vendor, funding source, account code, item or service being purchased, and supporting documentation needed for Procurement review. Below is a detailed walkthrough of the Banner requisition process, including the key fields users must complete before submitting the request for approval.
Complete the content above before moving on.
How To: Requisition Entry
Requisition Entry in Self-Service
Summary
Banner Links Homepage
Make your way to the Banner Links landing page and click on "Finance Self-Service".
Finance Self-Service
Click on "My Requisitions".
My Requisitions Homepage
The "My Requisitions" homepage shows an initiator's requisitions broken down by status: Draft Requisitions : Includes requisitions that have been entered but not submitted. Pending Requisitions : Includes those that have been submitted but not yet completed/fully approved. Completed Requisitions : Includes those that have been fully approved. Completed requisitions are converted to Purchase Orders (POs). The status of the POs, and finalized PO#, can be found under the 'status' column. Click on the "Create Requisition" button in the top right corner of the screen to create a new requisition.
Requestor Information
Update the following: Delivery Date : Set the delivery date to the expected delivery date of the requested commodity or service. Public Comment : Here you can add notes for the requisition. Typically, the ORA Budget Officers and Procurement Staff like to see the initiator's name, campus extension, office location, and award title. Ship To Location: For most procurements select "WSCPP" and do not update the "Attention To" section. Click the "Next" button at the bottom of the page. Please Note: This page will auto complete default cells based on your Banner profile. As a result, you may need to change the listed Organization.
Vendor Information
Update the following: Uncheck the "Choose vendor for me" box. Either (1) enter the Vendor ID of your chosen vendor or (2) search the vendors name. Be certain you select the appropriate vendor record as some vendors may have several mailing addresses or departments/divisions on file. Click the "Next" button at the bottom of the screen.
Add Item & Accounting (Step 1)
In the "Add Item(s)" section type a brief description of the commodity or service then click the blue "Add as new item" line.
Add Item & Accounting (Step 2)
Update the following: Unit of Measure: Select the best option for your procurement type. For the majority of procurements, EACH (EA) is the best option. Quantity: For services the quantity would be 1. For commodities it should reflect your order's item count. Unit Price: The per item price of your commodity/service. Click the "Save" button at the bottom of the screen.
Add Item & Accounting (Step 3)
You can repeat the previous two steps to add additional items as needed to the requisition. After adding all items click on the "Add Accounting" button at the bottom of the screen.
Add Item & Accounting (Step 4)
Update the following: Index: Each budget in Banner has a 6-digit index code. Once entered, the Fund, Organization, and Program cells should automatically populate. Account: Banner budgets are organized into budget pools, and each pool includes specific account codes that identify the type of expense being charged. A list of Banner account codes is attached below this section. Activity: This will be mostly relevant for cost share activity and is described in greater detail in our It Takes a Village: Understanding Cost Share on Sponsored Projects e-module. Click the "Save" button at the bottom of the screen. To submit the requisition click the "Submit Requisition" button.
Please Note: Remember to have your supporting documentation on hand and verify budget availability prior to requisition entry.
